notes:
- Old palace dramas: 孙公公 is said ខុនទីស៊ុន (not "គុងគុងស៊ុន"), 太监 ខុនទី, and 锦衣卫 / 东厂 by meaning (កងរក្សាព្រះអង្គ), not as a name.
- A short piece that only says the end of the line before again ("不好好" after "…对谁都不好") is no longer voiced twice.
- Names: a line that says a listed name another way ("子航" as "ជឺហាង", the list says "ហ្ស៊ីហាំង") is pointed out to the proofreader, who puts the list's name in.
